phases.name: Fix invoice money arithmetic
phases.goal: All invoice totals are computed once, in integer cents via vendor/acme-kit/money, and shared by the list, detail and CSV endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/invoices/2 returns total 135.00 (shipping DECIMAL string no longer concatenated)
Subtotal, discount, shipping, total and line totals are exact to the cent on every endpoint showing them: list, detail, CSV
Discount is rounded to the cent half away from zero via money.percent (INV-1043 discount 1.01, total 1.00; INV-1044 subtotal 60.47, discount 6.05, total 59.41)
CSV TOTAL row and line totals equal the JSON API values for every fixture invoice
Existing tests pass and npm test is green

tasks.title: Fix BILL-311: integer-cent invoice totals shared by JSON and CSV, with regression tests
outputs: failing reproduction test first (purpose reproduction), then the fix
CSV route reusing computeTotals instead of its own float math
regression tests for all fixture invoices and CSV==JSON
acceptanceCriteria: First step: a failing reproduction test (run with --purpose reproduction) shows INV-1042 total 12015.00 instead of 135.00 and the cent errors on INV-1043/1044
Root cause 1 fixed: DECIMAL strings (shipping_fee, unit_price) converted with money.fromDecimal at the repository boundary, no string concatenation or float math
Root cause 2 fixed: discount computed with money.percent (half away from zero), not unrounded floats then toFixed
Root cause 3 fixed: CSV route uses the same computeTotals as the JSON endpoints so CSV TOTAL and line totals equal JSON
GET /api/invoices (list), GET /api/invoices/:id and the CSV export all show correct totals for invoices 1-4 (50.00, 135.00, 1.00, 59.41)
Response shapes unchanged: string amounts with 2 decimals, 404 envelope intact; existing tests pass (npm test)

verification.method: run the project test suite, including new regression tests
